jobs.title: Finance & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America’s drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment.

As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We’re hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years.

What you will be doing

As Finance & Operations Manager, you will own day-to-day finance operations and business administration for our Ukraine team. You will help ensure that payments, budgets, documentation, and recurring administrative processes run accurately, on time, and with clear visibility. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone comfortable owning processes end-to-end, working with external service providers, and bringing structure to a fast-growing environment.

Responsibilities

- Own day-to-day financial operations, including payment planning, payment coordination, and cash flow visibility

- Track budgets, actual spending, and operating expenses, helping the team maintain financial control as the business grows

- Monitor accounts payable and accounts receivable and ensure financial commitments are tracked and followed through

- Coordinate with external accounting and administrative service providers on accounting, documentation, payroll, and related recurring processes

- Prepare regular financial and operational reporting to support management decision-making

- Maintain contracts, financial documentation, registers, and recurring operational deadlines

- Coordinate employee-related administration, including payroll inputs, benefits, insurance, and other recurring processes

- Support the administrative side of employee onboarding and offboarding in coordination with internal teams and external providers

- Identify gaps and inefficiencies in finance and administrative workflows and help improve them

- Build and maintain clear processes, documentation, and SOPs within your area of ownership

- Work closely with the Operations Lead and other teams in Ukraine and the US to support the growing Ukraine operation

You should have the following

- 3–5+ years of experience in finance operations, financial control, management accounting, finance & administration, or a similar hands-on role

- Practical experience with budgeting, cash flow management, payment operations, and expense control

- Good understanding of P&L and management reporting

- Experience working with Ukrainian legal entities and local financial and administrative requirements

- Experience coordinating with outsourced accounting or other external service providers

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and confidence working with financial data

- High attention to detail, particularly when working with numbers, documents, and deadlines

- Strong ownership mindset, you are comfortable independently managing your area and following things through to completion

- Ability to prioritize multiple recurring and ad hoc tasks in a fast-moving environment

- English at approximately B1+ level for written communication and collaboration with international colleagues

Nice to Have

- Experience in a startup, technology, defense tech, manufacturing, or other fast-growing environment

- Experience with people or HR administration

- Experience building finance or administrative processes from scratch

- Familiarity with working across Ukrainian and international teams

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America’s drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment.

As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We’re hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years.

What you will be doing

As Marketing Ops Manager, you’ll be the operational backbone of Neros’ Marketing team. You’ll run the project management platform, timelines, and cross-functional coordination that enable the team to execute content shoots, product launches, integrated marketing campaigns, media engagements, and more.

You will be the connector and convener of people and work streams, and package and share updates with leadership across the company. You’ll get to propose, implement, and iterate on the Marketing org’s project management philosophy and execution.

This is a builder-operator role for someone with 3–5 years experience in a fast-moving startup environments who wants to make an outsized impact (and accepts the outsized responsibility that comes with that). Your presence should improve both the quality and velocity of the work you project manage.

Responsibilities

- Own the Marketing org’s project management platform at the systems, process, and execution level

- (Cheerfully, aggressively) enforce adoption and adherence to these systems and process flows

- Implement a cadence of communications, both synchronous and asynchronous, to keep cross-functional stakeholders across Business Development, Mission Success, Gov’t Affairs, Engineering, Flight Test, and Legal informed of Marketing initiatives

- Proactively package and present org-wide status updates to senior leadership

- Surface and facilitate the resolution of risks and blockers for Marketing campaigns and initiatives

- Own delivery of post mortems and retrospectives

You should have the following

- 3-5 years experience in marketing ops/ program management/ project management, preferably in defense, aerospace, robotics, tech, or hardware industries

- Systems-level thinking skills as it relates to both inter and intra-organizational process and communication

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

- Exceptional attention to detail

- Demonstrated ability to use AI-assisted workflows to accelerate project management

- A love of sitting in the middle of all things, being the connective tissue, and colliding team members to find creative solutions

US Salary Range

$82,500 – $115,500 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are considered part of Neros' total compensation package.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all applicants without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

What you will be doing

You will own core workstreams and broadly support the Strategic Finance function (FP&A, Business Operations, Strategy, Corp Dev, etc.), partnering directly with the leader of Strategic Finance across the company's most important financial decisions.

- You’ll be responsible for owning Neros’ operating model including budgeting, forecasts, and corresponding analyses. You will be responsible for working across all facets of financial and operational problem-solving at Neros, including forecasting, budgeting, planning, business partnership, and analytics

- You will collaborate with senior leadership to assess and execute on key strategic opportunities and decision-making, including partnerships, M&A, and fundraising

- You will spearhead cross-functional initiatives and align stakeholders to solve unstructured problems

- This is a unique opportunity to help build the strategic finance function from the ground up at a generational company

- If you’re someone who’s excited about building and having tangible impact, not just crunching through models and slide decks, then this role is for you

You should have the following

- 2-5 years of progressive experience in investment banking, private equity, venture capital, management consulting, venture-backed startups, or similar high-performance environments

- Exceptional problem-solving, analytical, and corporate finance skills

- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

- A strong sense of mission and a desire to have impact at scale

- Genuine interest in defense, hardware, and manufacturing
